links.comparator_used: Physician evaluation of LLM free-text responses to real clinical cases (more than 400 physicians across seven specialties), compared with an equal number of AI agents configured to mirror physician characteristics
links.outcome: Agreement of automated AI-agent evaluation with physician evaluation of LLM responses, and efficiency of the evaluation
links.effect: No numeric effect given in the text. AI agents gave 'highly efficient, directionally aligned assessments' but did not fully capture the nuances of human clinical judgment and could not substitute for physician evaluation.
links.tradeoff: AI evaluators missed nuances of human clinical judgment and could not replace physician-centered evaluation. They are suggested only as assistive tools to triage or pre-screen outputs and reduce human burden.
links.quote: While AI agents delivered highly efficient, directionally aligned assessments, they did not fully capture the nuances of human clinical judgment and could not substitute for physician-centered evaluation.

design_hint: physician review vs AI-agent evaluation of LLM outputs
